finding: Photo previews use the wrong PhotoSize
detail: Selector picks by byte size not pixel box, so previews land on Telegram's 320/800/1280 boxes instead of Desktop's 520px rescale. Wrong in both directions.
scope: +54.18 MB; 552 previews too large (median 3.1x, max 22x), 13 too small

finding: Link previews promoted to real message media
detail: Desktop writes no media key for MessageMediaWebPage. We write a top-level photo plus photo_file_size/width/height on 21 messages, and a full file/media_type video_file block on 2 more.
scope: 23 messages; 21 dangling JSON refs; 42 broken img tags; 474 photo filenames shifted
status: fix landed after the compared export; re-confirm on next live run

finding: Service-message names resolve to empty string
detail: inviter is empty on every join_group_by_link; members[0] empty on 2 invite_members. Desktop resolves all of them. Residue of the 206-empty-names bug; participants.json is clean at 43/43, so the roster path is fine and the service-message path is not.
status: fixed 2026-08-29: engine/peers.rs learn_service_actors; awaiting live confirmation

detail: Desktop reuses one file for a repeated document and writes a second thumbnail with a ' (1)' suffix. We are strictly 1:1.
scope: 46 refs collapse to 20 basenames in Desktop; 9 redundant photos (3.33 MB); 74 file + 74 thumbnail paths shifted

finding: custom_emoji document_id left as numeric id
detail: Desktop downloads the emoji document and rewrites document_id to its path. We keep the number, so 3 AnimatedSticker*.tgs are never planned.
scope: 10 reaction entries + 1 text entity; 3 files not fetched
status: known ceiling: the media leg's 830 of 836

finding: Reactions carry too many recent reactors and no count span
detail: Desktop caps recent at 3 and appends a count span when there are more reactors than avatars (95 spans, all exact). We emit the full list up to 11 and no count span. Desktop also omits recent entirely on 19 reactions; we always write it.
scope: 209 messages; 1601 avatars vs Desktop's 1443; 0 count spans vs 95

finding: Sticker preview is a byte-copy of the sticker
detail: _thumb.webp hashes identically to the sticker itself. Same fetch_preview branch as R1 -- when Telegram advertises nothing smaller the full file is copied, and for stickers that branch is always taken. Also emits AnimatedSticker_thumb.tgs, a Lottie file offered as an image preview.

finding: Userpic colour class off by one
detail: Desktop's class set is {1,2,4,5,6,7,8,19}; ours is {1,2,4,5,6,7,8,18}. style.css defines only 1-8 so both render unstyled.
scope: 494 occurrences of userpic18; userpic19 never emitted
status: fixed 2026-08-29 in convert/names.rs learn_user; awaiting live confirmation

finding: Userpic initials computed two different ways
detail: We disagree with ourselves -- the same person renders 'A' in one place and 'AR' in another. One path uses Desktop's first+last initial rule, another splits the display name on whitespace.
scope: 29 occurrences across 5 people, all in reaction avatars
status: fixed 2026-08-29: the roster now goes through NameBook::learn (enrich.rs add_member_facts) instead of writing two of four maps by hand

finding: Coordinates not rounded to 6 decimal places
detail: Desktop writes 44.857507; we write 44.857507352853844. Shows up twice per message -- in location_information and in the map URL in the HTML. The only floats in the corpus.

finding: export_results.html drops three fields it already holds
detail: topic_closed is true for two topics in our own JSON but the page shows only 'pinned'. Topic creator populated and not rendered. Invite link populated and not rendered (arguably deliberate -- it is a live credential to a private group).
status: fixed 2026-08-29: markers joined, creator rendered, invite link shown as [INVITE LINK] by choice

finding: JSON metadata disagrees with the file on disk
detail: Four photos are served as photoSizeProgressive. Desktop assembles it; we record the progressive size's dimensions then download the largest plain photoSize. In 3 of 4 cases the lower-resolution file is the larger file.

finding: Forwarded header shown or suppressed on 117 messages
detail: Desktop shows the forwarded userpic and origin name on some joined messages and suppresses it on others, and we disagree with it. The discriminator is not recoverable from result.json -- not the sender, not the origin (joined already implies same origin 573/573), not media type, not the reply, not the date gap.
scope: 117 of 814 forwarded messages (59 one way + 58 the other)
